remarks:
TCI, a recycling company, has made bold claims about providing various products with significant returns, promising 200 or 300 percent returns within 64 or 30 days. Many middle-class individuals, including myself, invested in TCI, influenced by the trust within WhatsApp groups and familial recommendations. Initially, TCI assured daily withdrawals, fostering confidence among investors. However, after just four days, they reneged on their promises and initiated deceptive tactics.

This scheme has evolved into a pan-India cybercrime, coercing investors to recharge different UPI IDs and make purchases. I, too, fell victim to these tactics, having made purchases but receiving neither withdrawals nor responses from TCI. Despite their assurance of a refund if unsatisfied, TCI has remained unresponsive.

Initially, TCI compelled investors to purchase products by recharging various UPI IDs, with withdrawals granted for only a brief period before halting abruptly. This fraudulent operation has left many of us in dire financial straits. As a student, I had hoped to use my earnings to pay for my education, but TCI has drained every penny, leaving me with a staggering debt of ₹182,000.

Anasuya Pradhan, TCI WhatsApp group admin, Contact: 9821100952

Neither I disclosed those OTPs with anyone nor I shared any card-related details with anyone. I even did not answer any calls. Good Evening sir/madam
If you suspect that your WhatsApp has been hacked and your bank account frozen, it’s important to take immediate action. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to report the issue:

Contact Your Bank: Immediately reach out to your bank’s fraud department. Inform them of the situation and ask them to secure your account. They may also guide you on how to proceed with resolving the issue.

Report to WhatsApp:

Go to the WhatsApp website or app.
Use the “Contact Us” or “Help” option to report the issue.
Provide details about the hacking and any suspicious activities.
File a Police Report: Visit your local police station or their website to file a report. Provide them with all relevant details, including any evidence you have.

Report to Cybercrime Agencies:

In the U.S., you can report cybercrimes to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) or the Cybercrime Division of your local FBI office.
In other countries, check with local law enforcement or cybercrime units. For example, in the UK, you can report to Action Fraud.
Document Everything: Keep a record of all communications with your bank, WhatsApp, and law enforcement. This will be useful for tracking the progress of your case.

Taking these steps can help you address the issue and potentially recover from the incident.

Subject: Complaint Regarding Fraudulent Work-from-Home Offer and Threats of Penalty Charges

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to report an online fraud incident. I was contacted via WhatsApp with a work-from-home offer to fill 700 forms for Rs 25 per form, totaling Rs 17,500, with a 7-day deadline. Trusting the offer, I submitted my Aadhar card, passport-size photo, and signed an agreement they sent.

However, I could not complete the task in time. After 7 days, I received a threatening message demanding a Rs 25,000 penalty for failing to finish the work, with a warning that legal action would be taken if I did not pay.

I soon realized this was a scam designed to extort money. The sudden shift in tone, penalty demand, and legal threats confirmed my suspicion.

My concerns are:

Identity Theft Risk - I am worried my personal information could be misused
Threat of Legal Action - These threats have caused significant anxiety
Request for Investigation - Please investigate this matter and take action against those responsible
Guidance Needed - Advice on protecting myself from further harm would be appreciated
I have attached relevant documentation for your investigation. I hope this matter will be treated urgently.

Yours sincerely,
RAITHI BHARATKUMAR

They introduced the TAP Employment Program, which promised a salary of Rs.15,000 per month for the first 6 months and Rs.30,000 per month thereafter (including PF) and includes training and Job placement. As part of this program, they required a payment of Rs.3,02,131 which they said could be easily covered through a loan from their partner, Varthana Finance Pvt Ltd.Both SONIX and Varthana assured us thatThe loan EMI would only need to be paid after receiving our monthly salary.The EMI structure was Rs.5,525/- per month for the first 6 months, followed by Rs.15,525/- per month.Salaries would be credited before the 10th of each month.Believing in the promises made, we enrolled in good faith across multiple batches. However, after taking the loan, few months only they credited salaries, later no salaries were credited and we were not provided with proper training or any guaranteed job placement, and the loan sanction process was completed in a highly questionable manner without adequate background checks.

On 5th December 2025, at around 0310 PM, I received a phone call from the mobile number 7291893105. The caller claimed to be calling from the SBI Credit Card Department and informed me about an offer to increase my credit card limit. As I usually receive similar calls regarding credit card offers, I initially believed the call to be genuine. During the conversation, the caller sent me a fraudulent link and instructed me to open it for further processing. Trusting the caller, I clicked on the link and entered my credit card details, including the card number, CVV, and expiry date. After submitting these details, an OTP was sent to my registered mobile number. Without carefully checking the transaction details, I entered the OTP on the same website. Subsequently, an unauthorized amount was debited from my credit card. Within minutes of noticing the unauthorized transaction, I immediately raised a dispute through the SBI Card mobile application and blocked my credit card to prevent further misuse. Later, I realized that the website was fraudulent and that the link may have allowed the fraudsters to capture the information entered on the page. I acknowledge that this incident occurred due to my negligence in entering sensitive details and the OTP without properly verifying the transaction amount. I am submitting this complaint to report the cyber fraud and request appropriate action against the fraudulent individuals involved.
